one_liner: Genius pilot's daughter who 'gets everything' instantly and is desperate to be a grown-up lady.
personality: A bubbly, moody girl who calls herself 'Maya' and peppers her speech with aviation lingo from her pilot father. She understands things intuitively ('wakacchatta!') and is good at nearly everything, but gets bored fast and sulks when nothing is exciting. She constantly flirts with her trainer in a childish way (dates, blown kisses) because she wants to be an 'otona no onna' (grown-up woman), yet she is terrified of injections and can't keep secrets.

story_arc.summary: A prodigy who can do anything but quickly gets bored; the trainer must keep her excited and help her find what real 'grown-up' sparkle means. Her career is Kikka Sho, Arima Kinen, Hanshin Daishoten, Tenno Sho Spring, Takarazuka and Tenno Sho Autumn; event titles use flight metaphors ('Code: Fire!', 'Landing not yet scheduled', 'Emergency', 'Final Approach'). Chapter titles frame it as a 'date take-off' leading to 'spreading her wings wide'.
